title: Contract file front matter
description: The front matter of one contract file in design/contracts/ (#3148, ws-082): an acceptance criterion made formal, with the criteria a check proves and the check pinned by hash. The Markdown body after the front matter is the story and any detail; the criteria are listed here, so a reader never parses the body. Values stay within what YAML and JSON share.

schema.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only by a change to this schema.

id.description: Stable id: C, a dash and three or more digits, as studio numbers its contracts. Never reused, never renumbered.

title.description: What a person can do once the contract holds, in a few words.

state.description: draft: being written. approved: ready to build; only its state, checks and reviews change from here, and a changed contract is a new one that supersedes it. retired: nothing is built against it any more. Sealed once retired.

tier.description: The builder tier the contract is built at, when it is fixed rather than asked of the slice-tier decision point: one of the tiers the work kind declares (#3147). Null or absent to leave it to the point.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria, each with an id the check's tests are named after (a test named "a1: ..." checks a1) and the text it states. A work item that builds the contract lists criteria with the same ids in its acceptance, and an evidence record of a check run reports each by id. An approved contract states at least one.

checks.description: The contract's checks: test files a runner runs against the app (studio runs them with node --test and APP_URL), each pinned by the hash of its bytes, so chant workspace records reports a check edited after it was pinned. Usually one. Empty while none is written; records then warns record-no-evidence, and a factory leaves the contract unchecked.

references.description: Design assets a criterion is checked against besides its tests, such as a section of a driver's design document (design/drivers/D-001/design.html#notes-page). Optional.

asset.description: A workspace path, from the workspace root, with an optional #fragment naming a section in it.

supersedes.description: The contract or contracts this one replaces, by id: a bare id, as studio's contracts write it, or a list. Takes effect once this contract is approved or retired. Optional.

proposed_by.description: Who drafted the contract: the name chant workspace records new --by wrote (#2756). Null or absent when nobody named one.

approved_by.description: Who approved the contract: a forge login. A contract approved in a review session also carries the verdicts that approved it in reviews. Null while it is a draft.

approved_on.description: When it was approved, as YYYY-MM-DD. Quoted, so YAML reads it as a string. Null or absent while it is a draft.

reviews.description: Each reviewer's verdict on the contract, in the decision kind's shape: reviewer, verdict, on, and the digest of the text judged. A verdict given in a review session names it in session (chant workspace records review --session). Empty until a review happens.

digest.description: The digest of the contract text the verdict judged: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file with LF line endings and without its reviews block (#2672).

session.description: The id of the review session the verdict was given in.

seal.description: The reviewer's ssh signature over the verdict (#2687), as chant workspace records review --sign writes it.

then.description: A dissent needs a reason: the dissent by {reviewer} has no note.

seal.description: The author's ssh signature over the contract (#2688), as chant workspace records new --sign and amend --sign write it. Optional.

closed_digest.description: The contract's whole-file seal (#2546, ws-063), written when it is retired: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of {body, core}, line endings LF. chant workspace records reports record-seal-mismatch if the file changes afterwards.

then.description: An approved or retired contract names who approved it.
An approved contract states at least one criterion.

criterionId.description: A criterion's id, such as a1, unique in its contract.

workspacePath.description: A path from the workspace root, with / separators: no leading /, no . or .. segment, no empty segment, no backslash and no trailing /.

checkPin.description: A check file in the workspace, pinned by the hash of its bytes (#2549).

path.description: The check, from the workspace root, such as design/contracts/checks/C-001.test.mjs.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the check's bytes when it was pinned. chant workspace records pin <path> prints it.

as_of.description: When the check was pinned, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
